query: MATCH (a:StringConstant), (b:StringConstant) WHERE a.graphId <> b.graphId AND a.value = b.value AND a.value IN ['application/json', 'Content-Type', 'GET', 'POST'] RETURN a.graphId AS leftGraph, b.graphId AS rightGraph, a.value AS wireLiteral, count(*) AS pairs ORDER BY leftGraph, rightGraph, wireLiteral
